description: A comprehensive set of feature flags or identifiers associated with an entity (e.g., a user, organization, tenant, or API key). These features dictate access to specific functionalities, beta programs, or customized system behaviors. The presence of a feature string in this array indicates that the corresponding capability is enabled for the entity.

items.description: A unique, machine-readable string identifying a specific system feature. These are typically used as flags to enable or disable functionality on a per-entity basis. The format is usually kebab-case for consistency and programmatic ease of use.
